title: Local agents
intro: A hosted Floorbit can't reach LibreNMS on the event network. A local agent runs there instead, connects out to this Floorbit and answers its questions. Nothing on the event network has to be reachable from outside.
none: No agent yet. Floorbit asks its own monitoring plugin.
inUse: While an agent is enrolled, Floorbit asks the agent instead of its own monitoring plugin. Revoke every agent to go back.
outdatedHelp: Speaks an older agent protocol than this Floorbit ({{v}}). Pull the new floorbit-agent image and start the agent again.
stats_one: 1 call in the last hour, answered in {{ms}} ms
stats_other: {{count}} calls in the last hour, answered in {{ms}} ms (median)
statsNone: No calls in the last hour
hallsHelp: With an agent per hall, each answers for its own switches; the device list comes from all of them.
revokeQuestion: Revoke {{name}}? It stops at its next request and needs a new key.
name: Name
nameHelp: The event or the site it runs at, such as “Spring LAN, hall 2”.
madeHelp: Copy the key now: it is shown this once. Give it to the agent as FLOORBIT_AGENT_KEY.
runTitle: Start the agent on the event network
docs: How the agent works and what it is asked: docs/agent.md.
authBlocked: Login to {{device}} with {{credential}} failed {{when}} ({{message}}). Not tried again until cleared.
rotateQuestion: Make a new key for {{name}}? The old one keeps working until the agent uses the new one, for 24 hours at most.
rotatedHelp: Copy the key now: it is shown this once. Put it into the agent's FLOORBIT_AGENT_KEY and start the agent again; the old key stops working then, or in 24 hours.
oldKeyWorks: The old key still works until {{when}}, or until the agent uses the new one.
pluginsOffHelp: On here, but run by another agent: this one doesn't start them.
pluginsOffNone: None: it runs every plugin that is on

updates.title: Plugin updates

policy.approve: Plugin updates wait for approval on the agent
policy.off: Keeps the plugins of its image

updates.noKey: no signing key in its image: no updates

ha.single: One instance. With several (FLOORBIT_CLUSTER=redis), one takes over when another stops.
ha.pods_one: 1 instance shares the work over Redis.
ha.pods_other: {{count}} instances share the work over Redis.
ha.redisOff: Redis is not used or not answering: live updates stay on this instance.
ha.redisDown: Redis is not answering: the instances can't share live updates or agent calls.
ha.groupsHelp: Agents that answer for the same halls back each other up. With VRRP on them (FLOORBIT_AGENT_VRRP_VIPS), the one holding the first address is the primary: only it polls devices and logs in, the others take over within seconds.

help.ok: If the primary stops, a standby takes over its addresses.
help.single: No failover: enrol a second agent for these halls and turn VRRP on for both.
help.degraded: The primary runs, but a backup agent is offline: there is no failover right now.
help.no_primary: The agents are connected, but none holds the first address. Check keepalived on them.
help.no_vrrp: Several agents answer here without VRRP: each polls the devices. Turn VRRP on for all of them, or give them different halls.
help.split: Two agents both think they are primary: they can't hear each other. Check the VLAN, or set FLOORBIT_AGENT_VRRP_PEERS.
help.down: No agent for these halls is connected.
